full_page.content:
1925, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 25
July 1st St. Vitis D. Leo Schneider 8. of 3668 Seminole, enrolled on June 21st (Br. Fr.) as against St. Vitus dance and paralisis. At that time unable to get out of bed having ice-bags on his heart. To- day visits Monastery quite well. Deo Grat.
3 Pernecius Enemia Mrs. Naeve 48, 1407 Seward Ave suffering near- ly 5 years with pernicious Enemia; after 10 blood transfusions, wishing to die rather than take another such transfusion, is En- rolled To-day in S.M. A. for yr. Mrs. Naeve returned the follow- ing June in perfect Health.
8th Herman Fury 20, 8132 Willard, 12 years sick with bad stomach, spleen etc. look very bad - enrolled To-day for 2 yrs.
"Will He Die Impenitent?" asked his cousin - His Wife - A.C. Charles Jarrait 75, 1315 Elmwood, away from confession 50 years and Expected to die any day of terrible cancer, was enrolled last January. We enroll him again To-day in God's Holy Name
July 15 Cronic Penticitis Cured. Mrs. Georgia Bowers 49 not a Catholic 1028 Chene Ave - ten days down "in Most extreme Agony" is enrolled in S.M. A. July 8th just a week to-night comes this evening in per- son to say that she was able to get up next day - going to work to-morrow. "Thanks be to God!" - Takes a Catechism home to study.
17 Work Obtained Sadie Grewer 21 1612 ParkView Enrolled yesterday looking for work - Enrolled herself yesterday. got quite ideal position To-day.
20 Insane Wife Enrolled Mrs. Virginia Belleau, 24, mother of 3 little children 18 months in Ontario Hospital for insane is enrolled To- day a perpetual member.
Insanity Brings Blessing. Mrs. Eliz Leise elderly Husband non Cath. in Dearborn Asylum 5 months wnen Enrolled in S.M. A. came home first on July 4th Now O.K. Dr. Clarke declared it "nothing less than a miracle."
Page 26 July 26 49 Inch Dwarf At 17 Wishes To Start Growing. Non-Catholic. Russell Jay just 17 years to-morrow and 49 inches tall is enrolled in the S. M.A. To-day -- Asks Fr. S. to "make me grow." He will sign his name: - (Russell Jay) 1927, Jan. 2nd Reported grew 42 inches. - 1st change in 12 years - now developing normally .
